args.text: Popcorn shop. Top: customers waiting at a counter wanting popcorn. Middle: some kitchen with a tank and a hook. Bottom: a red popcorn machine inside a ring (red/blue/white arc, a little gauge needle). Coins 0. Bottom card: 30 coins, +4 -> +6, up arrow - an upgrade I can't afford. I think I tap or hold the popcorn machine to pop corn; the ring looks like a timing/heat meter. Expect popcorn to come out and go to customers.

Two taps on the machine -> popcorn went up to the middle station, into a bucket, customers took it and I got +8 each, 16 coins. The upgrade card at the bottom is filling with yellow as I get closer to 30. Nice, clear loop. I'll keep tapping to afford the upgrade. Wondering what the ring/dot around the machine means - timing?

32 coins. Tapping the middle station selected it: bottom card switched to its upgrade (250 coins, 15>20) and a stats panel appeared (time 4.0>3.0, 15>20). So each floor has its own upgrade. The machine's upgrade was 30 - I can afford that now. Going to tap the machine floor to select it again and press the up arrow.

Bought the machine upgrade! Satisfying burst of popcorn, machine got an awning. Now +6 per batch, next level 54. Still don't get the ring around the machine - there's a white dot that moves, a yellow arc on the left, red arc top-left. Going to try holding the machine instead of tapping to see if the ring is a heat/hold meter.

Aha - holding makes a needle sweep clockwise around the ring! I held 2s and it ended near the top of the yellow arc / start of red. One of the 9 little dots under the machine turned gold. I bet releasing in the yellow zone is a 'perfect' pop and the red is burnt. Trying a 1.6s hold to land mid-yellow.

Got it! Holding ~1.8s releases right in the yellow - big popcorn spray, customer gives a heart and +10. The row of dots under the machine fills gold: 5 now, with a bigger 10th dot at the end. Feels like a streak/combo meter. Going for the full row.

Big popcorn explosion and the gold dots reset - I think filling the row gave a bonus burst. But now the counter is empty: no customers, and 3 filled buckets are piling up in the middle floor. So I'm now making popcorn faster than people come. The little sign top-left shows a bucket with dots filling - maybe customers coming? 50 coins, 4 short of the next machine upgrade.

Bought machine upgrade 2 - it's a cart with wheels now. Selected the counter floor: its upgrade costs 40, stats show 4.0>5.5 people and 15.0>11.0 seconds - looks like it brings customers more often. That's what I need: 7 buckets are stacked up waiting and nobody's at the counter. Only 16 coins though; waiting for customers to buy the stockpile.

Customers trickle in slowly, coins 26 creeping toward the 40 counter upgrade. Tried tapping the counter window to see if it calls customers. Waiting on customers feels a bit slow compared to the fun of timing the popcorn.
